raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MAR-SecondIdentityTargetingSocialProtection",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Informal sector workers may be reluctant to enroll in the NPR and SR due to concerns that their data will be used for tax enforcement.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct targeted outreach campaigns informing informal workers about data confidentiality safeguards and the social protection benefits of registration.",
      "evidence": "workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks of making them susceptible to taxation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Vulnerable groups such as illiterate persons, disabled individuals, and remote residents may face exclusion due to administrative and physical access barriers.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy mobile units, satellite communication, Citizen Service Centers, and inclusive engagement strategies under the Stakeholder Engagement Plan.",
      "evidence": "These groups could face administrative, cultural, economic, geographical, language, and social norm-related barriers when accessing services and benefits."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "System expansion and digital data collection could lead to personal data protection breaches or data privacy compromises.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement privacy-by-design standards, ensure strict adherence to Law 09-08, and provide software security enhancements alongside staff training.",
      "evidence": "Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Rapid growth of the registries could overstretch Ministry of Interior capacity and delay the full operationalization of the National Registry Agency.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide dedicated institutional capacity building and condition disbursement on specific performance-based conditions (PBCs) for NRA staffing and operations.",
      "evidence": "This rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Reliance on Excel spreadsheets and manual data extraction from national systems for project financial management creates risks of reporting errors and delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop and install dedicated financial management software to automate IFR preparation and annual project financial reporting.",
      "evidence": "use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges in terms of quality and timeliness"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Using shared budget lines (AMO-TADAMON) across multiple World Bank projects risks expenditure duplication or double-counting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish distinct, dedicated budget codes within the Ministry of Interior budget specifically tied to project PBC-related expenditures.",
      "evidence": "risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO-TADAMON” to justify expenditure... on programs already financed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Frequent climate shocks such as droughts may severely drop agricultural output and income, straining social safety net mechanisms.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize real-time location and welfare data in the NPR and SR to rapidly identify climate-affected households and dynamically deploy shock-responsive cash support.",
      "evidence": "climate-related shocks, primarily droughts, represent significant risks to the Moroccan economy"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Deployment of mobile enrollment equipment and computing devices could generate unmanaged electronic waste.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Enforce formal e-waste management procedures for IT hardware and batteries under existing asset management protocols.",
      "evidence": "Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste and its improper disposal."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Failure to establish automated death record updates from civil registries could leave deceased individuals in the NPR, compromising system integrity.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement automated electronic data exchanges between civil registry offices and the NPR, monitored via dedicated PBC milestones.",
      "evidence": "the removal of deceased registrants is equally important to ensure sustained efficiency."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Inaccuracies in the SR Proxy-Means Test scoring formula could result in inclusion and exclusion targeting errors for social protection programs.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform process evaluations, re-evaluate scoring formulas against household survey data, and test revised questionnaires on representative beneficiary samples.",
      "evidence": "develop a strategy to reduce potential exclusion and inclusion errors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Complications in managing optional maintenance tranches for legacy IT contracts could disrupt critical biometric and database systems.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formulate a concise Project Procurement Strategy for Development (PPSD) outlining practical procedures for contract maintenance management.",
      "evidence": "managing the optional tranches relating to the maintenance of the contracts listed above."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Cyclical and climate-related income drops among non-salaried workers could prevent regular health insurance contribution payments.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Use SR welfare scoring and dynamic data updates to identify vulnerable workers experiencing income shocks and offer temporary contribution support.",
      "evidence": "farmers... suffer from two patterns of irregularities in the flow of income: seasonal and annual cyclicality, which significantly affects their ability to pay."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Hiring contracted workers for technical and operational tasks could lead to non-compliance with World Bank labor and working condition standards.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate ESS2 gap-filling measures into the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan, including worker grievance mechanisms and OHS guidelines.",
      "evidence": "Gap-filling measures, such as access to a GM, have been included in the ESCP to ensure appropriate labor and working conditions"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Failure to finalize and adopt an acceptable Project Operational Manual within 60 days of effectiveness could cause project implementation delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Expedite POM preparation by building upon operational guidelines from the prior operation and securing early World Bank review.",
      "evidence": "No later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date... prepare a manual acceptable to the Bank (“Project Operational Manual” or “POM”)"
    }
  ]
}
